name: Tom Volz Unpaid Order Follow-Ups for WooCommerce
author: Tom Volz

sections.description:
An order was placed — but the payment never arrived.

Tom Volz Unpaid Order Follow-Ups for WooCommerce automatically follows up with customers when their WooCommerce order is still unpaid. Create multiple reminder rules, choose when each reminder should be sent, customize the email and include a direct payment link for the individual order.

The important difference is control: you are not limited to a single reminder.

Create several follow-ups with different delays and messages, apply them to Pending payment and/or On hold orders, and let the plugin stop further reminders automatically when the order is paid.

Why use it?

Multiple reminders — not just one

Create multiple reminder rules and build a complete follow-up sequence.

For example:

  • First reminder after 24 hours
  • Another reminder later with different wording
  • A further follow-up when the order is still unpaid

Each rule can have its own delay, status, subject, heading and email content.

Direct payment link

Every reminder can include the payment link for the individual unpaid order.

The customer can use the link to continue payment without having to search for the original order.

Stop automatically when paid

Once the order is paid, the follow-up process stops automatically. You do not need to manually remove scheduled reminders for orders that have already been completed.

Works with existing unpaid orders

New rules are applied automatically to matching new orders. Existing unpaid orders can also be synchronized so they can enter the reminder workflow.

See what is happening

The dashboard gives you an overview of unpaid orders and reminder activity, while individual orders show reminder count and the last reminder timestamp.

Features

  • Multiple reminder rules with no artificial rule limit
  • Different delay for each reminder rule
  • Apply rules to Pending payment, On hold, or both
  • Custom subject, heading and email content for each rule
  • WordPress visual email editor
  • Direct payment link for the individual unpaid order
  • Automatic stop when the order is paid
  • Manual follow-up action from WooCommerce orders
  • Test email for each saved rule
  • Synchronize existing unpaid orders
  • Reminder count and last reminder timestamp
  • Dashboard with unpaid orders and reminder activity
  • WooCommerce Action Scheduler integration
  • HPOS compatibility declared

How it works

  1. Create a reminder rule.
  2. Choose the order status and delay.
  3. Customize the subject, heading and email content.
  4. Add the payment link placeholder where customers should continue payment.
  5. Save the rule.
  6. Matching unpaid orders are scheduled automatically.
  7. Further rules can create additional follow-ups.
  8. Reminders stop automatically when the order is paid.

Free and Pro

The free plugin provides the core unpaid-order follow-up workflow, including multiple reminder rules, payment links, flexible delays, test emails and existing-order synchronization.

An optional Pro version adds additional recovery controls such as product and category exclusions, payment-method rules, coupons, recovery analytics and automatic order cancellation.

Placeholders

  • {customer_name}
  • {order_number}
  • {order_total}
  • {payment_link}
  • {site_name}

Requirements

WooCommerce 8.0 or newer.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate Tom Volz Unpaid Order Follow-Ups for WooCommerce.
  4. Open Unpaid Order Follow-Ups in the WordPress admin.
  5. Create your first reminder rule.
sections.faq:
Can I create more than one reminder?

Yes. The free plugin supports multiple reminder rules, so you can build a multi-step follow-up sequence.

Can each reminder have different timing?

Yes. Each rule can have its own delay.

Can I include a payment link?

Yes. Use {payment_link} to include the payment link for the individual unpaid order.

What happens when the customer pays?

Further follow-ups stop automatically when the order is paid.

Can I follow up existing unpaid orders?

Yes. Existing Pending payment and On hold orders can be synchronized.

Can I test a reminder before using it?

Yes. Each saved rule has a test email function.

Which order statuses are supported?

Rules can be applied to Pending payment, On hold, or both.

How are delayed reminders processed?

The plugin uses WooCommerce Action Scheduler for delayed processing.
sections.changelog:
2.0.3

  • Finalized plugin name as Tom Volz Unpaid Order Follow-Ups for WooCommerce.
  • Requested the new WordPress.org slug tom-volz-unpaid-order-follow-ups-for-woocommerce.
  • Removed the previous one-rule restriction.
  • Added support for multiple reminder rules in the free plugin.
  • Added a distinct plugin prefix for functions, classes, options and hooks.
  • Updated plugin and product website links.
  • Removed recovery analytics from the free dashboard; recovery analytics remain part of the separate Pro version.

2.0.0
